authoritative_for: Clew owns user-reported application statuses and arbitrary notes in an append-only ledger, current/history reads, exact retry identity, corrections and its program installation.
Clew owns deterministic application email selection, frozen message occurrences, submission recovery, email admission maintenance and its product schedule definition.
not_authoritative_for: The user supplies status and resolves ambiguity with the agent. Cast owns job identities and retained job details. Platter owns prepared material and supplies legacy migration mappings.
Clockwork owns activation and failure halts. Email and Resend own submission acceptance; Gmail owns final inbox delivery.

covers: All public Clew outcomes for initialization, local integrity checking, complete retained-job search, reported status/notes, current/history reads, retraction and installation, including guarded schema-one ledger migration.
Daily application email previews, explicit sends and retries, retained occurrences, schedule definition generation and coordinated schedule lifecycle.
excludes: Help/version, implementation helpers, automatic interpretation, job discovery, application submission, employer contact, model execution and inbox delivery tracking.

shared_access_and_trust: The current user and their authorized agent invoke the local CLI. A search result does not authorize a write.
Explicit manual send authority or enabled daily binding authority is required to disclose the digest.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Ledger entries and output are private. Entries are retained indefinitely without automatic pruning. Usage observation contains only command identity and task correlation, not arguments or content.
Frozen mail is retained privately without automatic pruning. Authorized sends disclose complete selected notes, statuses, job details and links through Email.
compatibility_and_retirement: Ledger schema two and output schema two use Cast job identities. Coordinated deployment migrates schema-one state with a private backup and retained legacy aliases. Ordinary commands do not migrate state; old programs must not use a migrated ledger.
Email storage remains schema one. Frozen messages, send keys and acceptance receipts survive ledger migration. Preserve delivery state and use matching program and ledger versions for recovery.
operational_limits: Local full reads scale with retained history. The optional daily activation has a 180-second limit; no scheduling latency or inbox-delivery guarantee is supplied.
